periods.time: Seven Stars banquet and C-block first round
periods.label: 武曲去年度亚军

status.current: wins his C-block first-round match by forcing a ring-out

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Bukyoku teammate and friend who scolds Moroboshi to behave as champion.
relationships.momiji-asagi: Bukyoku teammate and fellow previous podium finisher.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Person Kiriko asks about Moroboshi's whereabouts before visiting Ittousei.

periods.summary: Jounosaki appears with Moroboshi and Asagi at the banquet as part of the previous year's top three. He criticizes Tatara's crude behavior and later is mentioned as winning C-block's third first-round match by sending his opponent out of bounds, immediately before Ikki versus Moroboshi begins.

key_events.summary: Joins Moroboshi in pressuring Tatara to back down.
Wins the C-block third match before Ikki's match.
